top news.title: Sources: the US has cleared ~10 Chinese companies, including Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance, and JD.com, to buy Nvidia H200 chips, but no deliveries have been made

tweets.author: @jimhansondc
tweets.text: NVIDIA scores the first big deal out of President Trump's China trip.  Cleared to sell the H200 chip to 10 Chinese companies opening perhaps a $50B market opportunity.  The H200 is a full generation behind NVIDIA's top chips Blackwell & Rubin so this is not a major technology jump but a pure commerce play.  It makes sure Jensen Huang has an opportunity to sell as many of the previous designs as possible.  This also retains the US competitive advantage for the newest fastest ones.

tweets.author: @chrisrmcguire
tweets.text: To explain: Huawei plans to ship 750,000 Ascend 950PR AI chips this year. Each 950PR has half the computing power and half the memory bandwidth of the H200. Selling 750,000 H200s to China on top of its existing 950PR production gives it the equivalent of 2,250,000 Ascend 950PRs. [image]

tweets.author: @adamscochran
tweets.text: China is actively using frontier AI to systematically attack US businesses. And giving North Korean hackers access to it. In one short meeting Trump folded on blocking the H200 chip sales. Embarrassing.

tweets.author: @lennysan
tweets.text: I'm actually surprised how rarely these big reorgs at top AI companies happen, given their pace.  They seem to happen every ~6 months, which is about the same rate as traditional hypergrowth companies.  Maybe this is the limit on how much humans can deal with such change.  Or, how long it takes to figure out something is broken, no matter your shipping pace.

top news.title: OpenAI debuts personal finance tools for US ChatGPT Pro users, partnering with Plaid to give access to 12K+ financial institutions to analyze spending and more

tweets.author: @fidjissimo
tweets.text: “Help me save money” is one of the core benefits people hope to get out of AI.  With this launch we're making this super easy.  Similar to what we did for Health by letting you connect your health records, you can now do the same for financial records so ChatGPT can have the full picture and give you more informed answers.

tweets.author: @racheltobac
tweets.text: Just worked w/ @CNN on a piece about why I wouldn't upload full financial docs (tax docs, statements, etc) to AI tools due to leakage & hacking risk. I don't recommend connecting bank accounts to AI tools. It becomes a 1 stop shop for attackers looking to drain your accounts🤖💸

tweets.author: @pitdesi
tweets.text: Hot take: Chat is useful for asking questions about money.  But it is not a good interface for managing money.  Finance is full of structured workflows... For those, you want purpose-built UI... Chat works best when intent is fuzzy: “Where did my money go?” or “What should I look at?”  But once the job becomes structured, repeated, visual, or high-stakes, UI wins.  People are way more likely to use a purpose-built UI that guides them than a chat window for this.  Like what @bchesky said about travel, similar thing here.
